agentCards.name: License Procurement Agent
agentCards.description: Checks software license availability and provisions licenses for employees.

skills.name: License Check and Provision
skills.description: Check license availability and provision for a user. Looks up current seat counts for the requested software title, verifies whether a license is available or must be purchased, and if available assigns and activates the license for the requesting employee, returning confirmation of the assignment.
examples: Does the marketing team have an available Tableau license for a new hire starting next Monday?
Please provision a Figma seat for employee jdoe@company.com under the design team license pool.
Check if there is a spare Adobe Creative Cloud license before purchasing a new one for the finance team.
